snippet.title: Hear My Cult - Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2509380/Hear_My_Cult/

Hear My Cult is an Action RPG with Rogue-Lite and RTS elements where you summon and command minions. You take the role of a cult summoner and necromancer, customizing an elemental deck of cards to build an army of units while gaining the favors of the Old Gods.
